example.title: Pier-end diner at the end of the Huntington Beach Municipal Pier (built 1992)

brief: The 1992 diner at the seaward end of the rebuilt municipal pier: a single-storey octagonal pavilion with a broad dark-red hipped roof crowned by a small octagonal lantern, white-painted walls with teal-framed windows and doors all round, a red neon script sign on the fascia over the door, standing on the widened concrete T-head of the pier among iron lamp standards and white pipe rails. Three photos. Pier piles 10 m below the bed (spec rule 4).
label: Solana Pier
